domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Trial Registration: German Clinical Trials Register DRKS00010820... Statistical significance in all analyses was set at alpha<.05 and was one-sided according to Cho and Abe [70].

overall_summary: The study has some concerns regarding risk of bias overall, driven by self-reported primary outcomes in an unblinded trial, substantial loss to follow-up, and the use of one-sided hypothesis testing.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to either the Reboot Online intervention or usual care control using a computer-generated random number sequence.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated randomly by an independent person using random.org, ensuring allocation concealment until assignment, and baseline differences were minor and addressed in analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eligible participants were randomized based on a random number sequence generated at www.random.org by a person independent of the study. Telephone interviewers remained blinded to participants’ group allocation; once randomization occurred, participants and study staff could not remain blinded to group allocation.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although blinding of participants and trial staff was not feasible given the nature of the digital intervention, participants followed their assigned conditions in an intention-to-treat framework without reported protocol deviations that could substantially bias the effect of assignment to intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Telephone interviewers remained blinded to participants’ group allocation; once randomization occurred, participants and study staff could not remain blinded to group allocation... To explore treatment efficacy, intention-to-treat linear mixed models with random intercepts for patients were estimated separately for each of the dependent variables.

domain_judgments.rationale: Missing data were balanced across groups (~21-24% at post-treatment), missingness was not predicted by baseline symptom severity, and linear mixed models robust to missing-at-random mechanisms were utilized.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of those participants in the intervention group, 61% completed all eight lessons (25/41) and 76% completed post-treatment and three-month follow-up online assessments (31/41). A comparable proportion of the UC group completed post-treatment questionnaires at the end of the study period (i.e., one week after the cessation of the active intervention phase, 79%). Eighty-five percent of both the intervention (35/41) and UC groups (33/ 39) completed the telephone diagnostic interview at three-month follow-up. None of the baseline painrelated, depression, or psychological distress symptom measures significantly predicted completing the active intervention phase of the RCT...

domain_judgments.rationale: Primary outcomes (PSEQ and BPI) were self-reported measures administered to participants who were aware of their treatment assignment (unblinded) in a trial comparing an active intervention with usual care.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants completed outcome measures at baseline, midpoint (week 8), post-treatment (week 16–17), and follow-up (three months after completing posttreatment questionnaires)... The Pain Self-Efficacy Questionnaire (PSEQ) was used to assess participants’ confidence to perform activities while in pain... The Brief Pain Inventory (BPI) was used to assess pain severity and its impact on function...

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered with prespecified primary and secondary outcomes, and results for all specified measures were fully reported according to an established statistical analysis plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The trial was prospectively registered on the Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry (ACTRN1261600024 9459), and the protocol was followed as per the registry.

overall_summary: The study is soundly randomized and analyzed using intention-to-treat mixed models, but receives an overall judgment of some concerns due to reliance on patient-reported subjective outcome measures in an unblinded trial design.
